leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Implement a function that compares two objects and identifies differences
Construct a recursive algorithm to handle nested object structures
Manipulate object properties to extract changed values between versions
Apply type checking to handle different data types during comparison
Initialize a result object to store identified differences systematically
Configure comparison logic to handle both added and removed properties
Integrate the diff utility into a test scenario to validate functionality
